run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system with a checkpoint and optional performance measurement
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy force and stress error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table with energy error force MAE and QPS columns
run_PerfCheckRunner: run a benchmark comparing an inference configuration against an fp64 baseline on default test systems
create_InferenceResult: create an InferenceResult dataclass with energy forces stress and optional performance metrics from a single inference run
